speaker: Doctor
text: The negative AMA rules out Primary Biliary Cholangitis, but the elevated alkaline phosphatase and bile duct thickening on ultrasound, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis, strongly suggest Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis.
